comment: Context assumptions: In the emerging technologies and AI section, the guidance may assume that the presence of human review is sufficient to provide meaningful oversight. In practice, human reviewers may defer excessively to AI outputs because of automation bias, perceived model authority, time pressure, or poorly calibrated trust. This is particularly important in health contexts involving vulnerable users, where formal human involvement may exist without providing an effective capacity to question, override, or correct an AI supported decision.
